[[File:Corrupted scorpion icon.png]]
'''Corrupted scorpions''' are monsters that require level 88 [[Slayer]] to damage. They can be found in the [[Sophanem Slayer Dungeon]]. A [[Feather of Ma'at]] is required to complete each kill. A cat named [[Katarina]] has a chance to spawn upon each successful kill.
